tools.name: explain_loan_basics
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a short explanation of how an Australian household solar or battery loan fits together. Do not use this to say they are eligible or approved, or to quote a personal rate. Do not collect a TFN, SSN, Medicare number, bank details, or card number.

tools.name: estimate_bill_savings
tools.description: Use this when you have daily kWh, tariffs, and a system size and want classroom energy-bill arithmetic. Do not use this as a quote, a savings guarantee, or a credit offer. Do not send an account or identity number.

tools.name: compare_scenarios
tools.description: Use this when comparing cash, a loan, and adding a battery later with numbers the caller already has. Do not use this to offer a rate or say they should borrow. A missing rate uses a labelled 7% teaching default, not a lender rate.

tools.name: explain_hesl
tools.description: Use this when explaining the NSW Home Energy Saver program: the loan cap, published income thresholds, what it can fund, and who delivers it. Do not use this to decide if a person is eligible or approved. Send them to energy.nsw.gov.au.

tools.name: explain_loan_options
tools.description: Use this when comparing cash, a personal or green loan, installer finance, a home-loan top-up, and the NSW Home Energy Saver Loan. Do not use this to rank a cheapest option or publish a rate as an offer.

tools.name: explain_solar
tools.description: Use this when explaining how rooftop solar meets a household bill: imports, exports, and STCs. Do not use this as a quote or a site assessment.

tools.name: explain_battery
tools.description: Use this when explaining what a home battery stores and why backup is a separate feature. Do not use this to recommend a product or promise bill savings.

tools.name: explain_insulation
tools.description: Use this when explaining ceiling insulation and draught-proofing, including the NSW loan list. Do not use this to specify a product or print a savings figure.

tools.name: decision_checklist
tools.description: Use this when preparing questions for an installer, a lender, or both. Do not use this to collect the answers, a TFN, an SSN, a Medicare number, bank details, or a card number.

tools.name: product_faq
tools.description: Use this when the question is about SparkReady or how household solar and battery loans usually work, and the public FAQ may cover it. Do not use this to invent an answer, assess an application, or request a TFN, SSN, Medicare number, bank account, or card.
